description: Defines a template class 'mac_map' for managing a map of objects keyed by MAC address, with utility functions for adding, retrieving, and maintaining entries, including a mechanism for updating and removing old entries.

classes.name: mac_map
classes.description: A map of objects keyed by MAC address, with methods for adding, retrieving, and managing entries, including a keep-new mechanism for updating entries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shared_ptr to an object of type T associated with a MAC address, constructing it if necessary.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an existing shared_ptr<T> to the map, or returns the existing one if present.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the shared_ptr<T> associated with a given MAC address, or null if not found.

methods.name: keep_new_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the map for a keep-new update cycle by storing current MAC addresses.

methods.name: keep_new
methods.description: Marks a MAC address to be kept during the update cycle.

methods.name: keep_new_remove_old
methods.description: Removes entries not marked to be kept, returning a list of removed entries.

methods.name: keep_new_remove_old
methods.description: Removes entries not marked to be kept, storing them in a provided collection.
